positions.subject: q:education/sfusd-proximity-assignment
positions.summary: Hazelton says enrollment should change to neighborhood assignments instead of the lottery, while keeping the option to apply to citywide language immersion and K-8 programs.

citations.quote: Our enrollment process needs to be finally changed to neighborhood assignments versus the current lottery system that forces families to rank schools.
He supports a zone-based model, in which students would be assigned to a neighborhood school close to their home.
citations.locator: Positions on Key Issues, student-assignment question

citations.quote: Make SFUSD easier to join by reforming the lottery system
citations.locator: Candidate statement, Board of Education, p. 29 (PDF page 31)
